key_insight: Coherent finite-resolution prices or predictions provide a constructive foundation for stochastic processes, unifying finance and machine learning through adjoint recursions and controlled lattice limits.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a route to numerically controlled pricing and prediction algorithms with explicit convergence rates rather than asymptotic orders alone.
method: Start from de Finetti’s coherent previsions on finite lattices.
Construct continuum limits with explicit renormalisation and checkable estimates.
Compute measure changes using Farkas’ lemma and link pricing to backpropagation through adjoint recursions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports sharp convergence rates for diffusion moments, Feynman–Kac values, and reweighted generators, with 67 Python scripts regenerating every numerical table and much of the finite-dimensional core verified in Lean 4.
watch_item: Continuum guarantees depend on regularity and well-behaved reweighting; the abstract provides no machine-learning benchmark results.
paper_title: Constructive Probability, Foundations and Numerical Analysis for mathematical finance and machine learning
